conventions.axes: glTF / Godot: +Y up, metres; every prop faces +Z (its front). +X is on the right of a viewer standing in front of the prop (e.g. the mast arm reaches out to +X). Yaw = atan2(front.x, front.z) turns +Z onto a front direction.
conventions.origin: ground: on the ground at the footprint centre. wall: on the wall plane at the mount point (the prop sticks out along +Z). span: midpoint between the two attachment points (scale X to the gap; the cables sag below it).
conventions.nodes: First node = the main mesh (named like the prop). Driven nodes (traffic lamps) are separate meshes with the same material. 'Collider' is a hidden mesh (extras: collider, shapes); use index collider.shapes for primitive shapes. Light_* empties carry extras {light, color, energy (W-ish), range}; local -Z is a spot's direction. Socket_* empties mark particle emitters (steam, smoke).
conventions.materials: One Pigment material per prop (base colour, ORM, normal, emissive with KHR_materials_emissive_strength). alpha BLEND = glass / holo / cut-outs: in Godot use transparency Alpha Depth Pre-Pass (or Alpha Scissor for cut-out-only props such as puddles and grilles).
conventions.variants: Swap the material's albedo (and emission) textures for variants/<prop>__<variant>_*; other maps are shared.
conventions.lod: Switch to files.lod1 beyond lod.lod1_from_m; hide beyond lod.visible_to_m (visibility_range_end).

slots.curb: line along the curb (front = towards the road). Props sit on the sidewalk, `offset` metres back from the curb face (negative = onto the walk).
slots.walk: line along the middle of the sidewalk (front = towards the road).
slots.frontage: line along building fronts at street level (front = away from the wall, towards the street). `offset` = distance out from the wall.
slots.facade: line along building walls, mounted at `mount_height` metres (wall-mounted props; origin = the wall mounting point).
slots.corner: junction corners: point at the curb apex, `dir` points from the sidewalk into the junction.
slots.crossing: pedestrian-crossing ends: point at the curb where the zebra meets it, `dir` points across the road.
slots.roadside: line along the road edge on the asphalt (front = along the traffic); roadworks, barriers.
slots.road: area: the carriageway (manhole steam vents, puddles).
slots.alley: line along alley walls (front = into the alley).
slots.alley_span: pairs of alley walls facing each other: the prop spans the gap (scale X to the `span`).

scatter_fields.slots: which slots the prop may use (keys of SLOTS)
scatter_fields.density: per district: instances per 100 m of line (line slots), per 100 m2 (area slots) or probability per point (corner / crossing); 'default' is the fallback
scatter_fields.offset: metres from the slot line along the front direction (negative = behind it); may be {slot: value}. curb: always onto the walk, frontage / alley: always out from the wall, at least half the prop's depth; corner / crossing: back from the curb face
scatter_fields.spacing: minimum distance (m) to another instance of the same prop
scatter_fields.clearance: radius (m) kept free of other props (and of context['blocked'])
scatter_fields.facing: front: 'road' = along the slot's front; 'wall' = opposite; 'along' = parallel to the line; 'random'
scatter_fields.cluster: [min, max] instances per placement, within cluster_radius
scatter_fields.along: corner/crossing: metres along the curb from the apex (sign picks a side)

signals.how_to_drive: Every lamp node shares the prop material and its emissive texels show the lit lens. To switch a lamp off, give that node a material override with emission disabled (or emission_energy_multiplier = 0); to switch it on, restore the shared material. Optional: an OmniLight3D at lamp_positions[name] tinted lit_colors[color].
